words.enDefinition: The legal process by which parties come to a binding agreement.

examples.en: The seminar separated contract formation from later duties in its fictional dispute about a student exhibition.
examples.zh: 讨论课用一则虚构的学生展览争议，区分「合同订立」与后续义务。

examples.en: We drew a timeline of contract formation from the first email to the final classroom agreement.
examples.zh: 我们画出「合同订立」时间线，从第一封邮件一直标到课堂案例中的最终协议。

words.enDefinition: An agreement creating obligations recognized and enforceable under the applicable law.

examples.en: The mock judgment asked whether the parties' exchange created a legally binding agreement about the exhibition space.
examples.zh: 模拟判决考察双方的交流是否就展览场地形成了「有法律约束力的协议」。

examples.en: We contrasted a legally binding agreement with a tentative plan in the fictional student committee's messages.
examples.zh: 我们对比了虚构学生委员会消息中的「有法律约束力的协议」和暂定计划。

collocations: a legally binding agreement between parties

words.enDefinition: Agreement of the parties to the same bargain, as shown by their words or conduct.

examples.en: The seminar found evidence of mutual assent in the two messages accepting the same exhibition date.
examples.zh: 讨论课从两条都接受同一展览日期的消息中找到了「双方合意」的证据。

examples.en: We asked whether mutual assent existed when the fictional groups had discussed different versions of the proposal.
examples.zh: 虚构的两个小组讨论的是不同版本的提议，我们于是考察是否存在「双方合意」。

words.enDefinition: The approach to assent that evaluates what parties' outward words or conduct reasonably communicated.

examples.en: The objective theory of contract directed our seminar toward what the fictional parties communicated through their messages.
examples.zh: 在「客观合意理论」下，讨论课着重考察虚构双方通过消息表达了什么。

examples.en: We applied the objective theory of contract before reading the parties' private notes in the mock case.
examples.zh: 在模拟案例中，我们先运用「客观合意理论」分析，再阅读双方的私人笔记。

collocations: apply the objective theory of contract
an example of the objective theory of contract
the role of the objective theory of contract

words.enDefinition: Words or conduct that outwardly indicate agreement to a proposed bargain.

examples.en: The fictional opinion treated the reply as a manifestation of assent to the quoted proposal.
examples.zh: 虚构判决意见将这条回复视为接受所引提议的「同意的外在表示」。

examples.en: We discussed whether returning the marked form amounted to a manifestation of assent in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了在课堂案例中，交回标记过的表格是否构成「同意的外在表示」。

words.enDefinition: The person or entity that makes an offer inviting acceptance.

examples.en: The exercise labeled the student club as the offeror because it sent the definite proposal first.
examples.zh: 习题把学生社团标为「要约人」，因为它先发出确定的提议。

examples.en: We checked which fictional offeror sent the second version before tracking what the recipient agreed to.
examples.zh: 考察收件人同意了什么之前，我们先确认是哪一位虚构的「要约人」发出第二个版本。

words.enDefinition: The person or entity to whom an offer is made.

examples.en: In the worksheet, the offeree received the exhibit proposal and replied to the terms stated in it.
examples.zh: 习题中的「受要约人」收到展览提议，并就其中列明的条款作出回复。

examples.en: The mock opinion distinguished the offeree from another student who merely received a copy of the email.
examples.zh: 模拟判决意见区分了「受要约人」和仅收到邮件副本的另一名学生。

words.enDefinition: A proposal showing willingness to be bound on stated terms if the other party accepts.

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the second email made a contractual offer about printing the fictional festival programs.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，第二封邮件是否就印制虚构节庆的节目单发出了「合同要约」。

examples.en: We identified a contractual offer by looking for words inviting agreement to specified terms in the mock exchange.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟交流中寻找邀请对方同意既定条款的措辞，以识别「合同要约」。

words.enDefinition: In English contract law, an invitation for others to make an offer rather than itself showing final commitment.

examples.en: The English law exercise asked whether the campus sale display was merely an invitation to treat.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法习题问，校园售卖展台的陈列是否仅为「要约邀请」。

examples.en: We marked invitation to treat beside the announcement inviting student groups to send their own proposals.
examples.zh: 我们在邀请学生团体提出各自方案的公告旁标注了「要约邀请」。

collocations: classify a display as an invitation to treat
distinguish an invitation to treat from an offer
an example of an invitation to treat

words.enDefinition: An offeree's agreement to a proposal in a manner that meets the applicable contract rules.

examples.en: The worksheet asked which message contained acceptance of an offer to share the fictional display space.
examples.zh: 习题问，哪条消息对共用虚构展览场地的要约作出了「承诺」。

examples.en: We identified acceptance of an offer in the example after comparing the reply with the initial proposal.
examples.zh: 我们将回复与最初提议作对照后，识别了例题中的「对要约的承诺」。

collocations: a valid acceptance of an offer

words.enDefinition: A question about an offer or possible changes that does not itself propose replacing the original bargain.

examples.en: The mock judge read the question about another time as a mere inquiry about the initial proposal.
examples.zh: 模拟裁判者把有关其他时间的问句理解为针对最初提议的「单纯询问」。

examples.en: We highlighted the tentative wording that made the message a mere inquiry in the English law exercise.
examples.zh: 在英格兰合同法练习中，我们高亮了使该消息成为「单纯询问」的试探性措辞。

collocations: classify a reply as a mere inquiry
distinguish a mere inquiry from a counteroffer

words.enDefinition: A response that makes agreement to an offer depend on the offeror agreeing to a further condition.

examples.en: We classified the fictional response as a conditional acceptance because it depended on a different room being included.
examples.zh: 虚构回复以另一个房间也纳入协议为条件，我们把它归为「附条件承诺」。

examples.en: The seminar compared conditional acceptance under a common law example and a separate model about goods.
examples.zh: 讨论课对比了一道普通法案例与一道货物案例中的「附条件承诺」。

words.enDefinition: Agreement to an offer without adding a condition or requiring a change to its terms.

examples.en: The mock judgment treated the short reply as unqualified acceptance of the terms in the last email.
examples.zh: 模拟判决将简短回复视为对上一封邮件条款的「无保留承诺」。

examples.en: We looked for unqualified acceptance after checking whether the fictional recipient had requested a different price.
examples.zh: 我们先核对虚构收件人是否要求另定价格，再寻找「无保留承诺」。

words.enDefinition: The traditional common law principle that acceptance must agree to the offer's terms without changing them.

examples.en: The mirror image rule mattered in the classroom case because the reply changed a term about payment.
examples.zh: 在课堂案例中，回复改动了一项付款条款，因此涉及「镜像规则」。

examples.en: We compared the mirror image rule with the separate goods rule summarized in the United States materials.
examples.zh: 我们将「镜像规则」与美国资料中概述的货物买卖专项规则作了比较。

collocations: an exception to the mirror image rule

words.enDefinition: Acceptance inferred from actions that reasonably communicate agreement under the applicable law.

examples.en: The mock judgment discussed acceptance by conduct after each fictional group acted on the same written proposal.
examples.zh: 虚构的两个小组都按同一书面提案行动后，模拟判决讨论了是否构成「以行为作出承诺」。

examples.en: We compared the words and actions in the exercise before deciding whether they showed acceptance by conduct.
examples.zh: 我们先对照练习中的言辞与行动，再判断是否显示「以行为作出承诺」。

words.zhGloss: 以完成所要求的行为承诺
words.enDefinition: Acceptance by carrying out the act an offer calls for as the means of agreement.
acceptedZhAnswers: 以完成所要求的行为承诺

examples.en: The hypothetical promised a prize for returning a lost notebook and used acceptance by performance to explain assent.
examples.zh: 假设案例承诺对送回遗失笔记本的人给予奖励，并用「以完成所要求的行为承诺」解释合意。

examples.en: In the worksheet, acceptance by performance occurred when the fictional student finished the act specified in the offer.
examples.zh: 习题中的虚构学生完成要约指定的行为时，构成了「以完成所要求的行为承诺」。

collocations: an offer inviting acceptance by performance
an example of acceptance by performance

words.enDefinition: Acceptance made by giving the promise requested by the offer.

examples.en: The tutor illustrated acceptance by promise with a fictional reply agreeing to provide printed programs next week.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用一则答应下周提供印刷节目单的虚构回复说明「以许诺作出承诺」。

examples.en: We distinguished acceptance by promise from completing the act first in the seminar's comparison of two offers.
examples.zh: 讨论课比较两项要约时，我们区分了「以许诺作出承诺」和先完成所要求的行为。

collocations: an offer inviting acceptance by promise

words.enDefinition: Withdrawal of an outstanding offer by the offeror, subject to applicable limits on revocability.

examples.en: In our mock timeline, offer revocation appeared between the first proposal and the recipient's attempted acceptance.
examples.zh: 模拟时间线上，「撤销要约」出现在首次提议与收件人试图承诺之间。

examples.en: We discussed offer revocation after placing each fictional message on the seminar's timeline of the exchange.
examples.zh: 我们把各条虚构消息按时间列入讨论课的交流时间线，再讨论「撤销要约」。

words.enDefinition: Conveying assent to the offeror in the manner required or recognized by the applicable rules.

examples.en: The classroom problem separated communication of acceptance from the recipient's private decision to agree to the offer.
examples.zh: 课堂题区分了「承诺的通知」与收件人私下决定同意要约。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which transmission counted as communication of acceptance in the fictional exchange about printed posters.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，在印制海报的虚构交流中，哪次发送构成「承诺的通知」。

collocations: the timing of communication of acceptance

words.enDefinition: A means, such as words or conduct, by which an offeree signifies acceptance.

examples.en: The class compared the mode of acceptance described in the model offer with the recipient's actual reply.
examples.zh: 我们把示例要约所述的「承诺方式」与收件人的实际回复作了对照。

examples.en: The New York goods exercise asked what mode of acceptance the fictional exchange reasonably invited.
examples.zh: 纽约州货物买卖习题问，虚构交流可以合理理解为允许哪一种「承诺方式」。

collocations: identify a permitted mode of acceptance
the mode of acceptance stated in an offer

words.enDefinition: Expiration of an offer after a stated or otherwise applicable period passes without acceptance.

examples.en: The seminar timeline showed lapse of an offer when the fictional proposal's stated response period ended.
examples.zh: 讨论课时间线显示，虚构提议的回复期限届满时发生了「要约失效」。

examples.en: We discussed lapse of an offer separately from a later message announcing the offeror's withdrawal.
examples.zh: 我们把「要约失效」与要约人后来发消息宣布撤回要约分开讨论。

collocations: the timing of lapse of an offer
distinguish lapse of an offer from withdrawal

words.enDefinition: An offeree's communication declining the offered bargain.

examples.en: The worksheet treated the words of the fictional recipient as a clear rejection of an offer.
examples.zh: 习题把虚构收件人的这番话视为明确「拒绝要约」。

examples.en: We distinguished rejection of an offer from a question about a second possible delivery date in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分了「拒绝要约」和询问是否可采用另一个交付日期。

collocations: a clear rejection of an offer

words.enDefinition: The legal ability of an offeree to make an agreement by accepting an outstanding offer.

examples.en: Our mock opinion considered whether the offeree still had the power of acceptance when the reply arrived.
examples.zh: 模拟判决意见考察回复到达时，受要约人是否仍有「承诺权」。

examples.en: We marked when the power of acceptance ended on the timeline of the fictional exchange in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在虚构交流的时间线上标出了「承诺权」终止的时点。

words.enDefinition: The common law rule that a properly dispatched acceptance can take effect on dispatch where the rule applies.

examples.en: Our American common law exercise applied the mailbox rule to acceptance sent by ordinary post in the hypothetical.
examples.zh: 我们的美国普通法习题将「邮寄承诺发信主义」用于假设案例中经普通邮寄发出的承诺。

examples.en: We compared the mailing and arrival dates before testing whether the mailbox rule mattered in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 我们比较寄出日期和到达日期，再看「邮寄承诺发信主义」是否影响虚构案例。

collocations: an exception to the mailbox rule
the timing under the mailbox rule

words.enDefinition: A rule under which an acceptance takes effect when received rather than when sent.

examples.en: The fictional problem used a receipt rule to compare when an immediate message was sent and received.
examples.zh: 虚构题目采用「承诺到达主义」，比较一条即时消息的发送和接收时间。

examples.en: We discussed the receipt rule after the English law worksheet specified when the telex message reached its recipient.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法习题说明电传消息何时到达收件人后，我们讨论了「承诺到达主义」。

collocations: the effective time under a receipt rule

words.enDefinition: An agreement that limits the offeror's ability to revoke an offer for an agreed period or on stated terms.
acceptedZhAnswers: 保持要约有效的选择权合同

examples.en: In an American classroom hypothetical, an option contract kept the campus print offer open for a stated period.
examples.zh: 美国课堂假设案例中，「选择权合同」使校园印刷要约在规定时间内保持有效。

examples.en: We read the option contract beside the underlying offer to distinguish the two agreements in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把「选择权合同」与其对应的要约放在一起读，以区分习题中的两项安排。

collocations: an option contract to keep an offer open
the duration of an option contract

words.enDefinition: A merchant's signed offer to buy or sell goods that assures it will stay open under applicable UCC rules.

examples.en: The New York case study asked whether the signed stationery proposal was a firm offer under the UCC.
examples.zh: 纽约州案例题问，已签署的文具提议是否属于「UCC 商人确定要约」。

examples.en: We read a fictional signed record before debating whether it contained a firm offer under the UCC.
examples.zh: 我们读过一份虚构的签署记录，再讨论其中的提议是否属于「UCC 商人确定要约」。

collocations: identify a firm offer under the UCC
an example of a firm offer under the UCC
the limits of a firm offer under the UCC

words.enDefinition: An exchange in which parties use conflicting standard forms and the resulting contract terms must be determined.

examples.en: The New York goods problem illustrated a battle of the forms with conflicting terms on two classroom documents.
examples.zh: 纽约州货物买卖题用两份条款冲突的课堂文件说明「格式之争」。

examples.en: We traced each added clause in the battle of the forms exercise before discussing the possible contract terms.
examples.zh: 讨论合同可能包含哪些条款前，我们先追踪「格式之争」练习中各项增订条款。

collocations: resolve a battle of the forms
a battle of the forms problem
a battle of the forms involving conflicting terms

words.enDefinition: An additional term substantial enough to prevent its automatic inclusion in a merchant contract under UCC rules.

examples.en: The New York exercise asked whether an added clause constituted a material alteration under the UCC.
examples.zh: 纽约州习题问，增订条款是否构成「UCC 下的重大变更」。

examples.en: We separated minor wording changes from a possible material alteration under the UCC in the fictional exchange.
examples.zh: 在虚构交流中，我们区分了细小措辞变动与可能的「UCC 下的重大变更」。

collocations: consider a material alteration under the UCC
a possible material alteration under the UCC
identify a material alteration under the UCC

words.enDefinition: A qualification signaling that parties do not yet intend to be bound before a formal agreement.

examples.en: The English seminar emphasized the words subject to contract printed at the top of the fictional draft.
examples.zh: 英格兰法律讨论课强调了虚构草案顶部印有「以正式订约为前提」几个字。

examples.en: We discussed whether the parties later departed from their subject to contract wording in the mock case.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了模拟案例中的双方后来是否不再坚持「以正式订约为前提」这一措辞。

collocations: mark a draft subject to contract
a proposal marked subject to contract

words.enDefinition: An understanding on main points while details or formal commitment may remain unsettled.

examples.en: The fictional teams reached an agreement in principle about the exhibition but left several details open.
examples.zh: 虚构团队就展览达成了「原则性协议」，还有若干细节未定。

examples.en: We read the exchange before deciding what the agreement in principle meant in the mock contract problem.
examples.zh: 我们读完交流记录，再判断模拟合同题里的「原则性协议」是什么意思。

collocations: an agreement in principle on key terms

words.enDefinition: The terms sufficiently important to the parties or law that agreement on them matters to contract formation.

examples.en: Our seminar identified the essential terms of the fictional printing deal before examining the parties' later conduct.
examples.zh: 讨论课先找出虚构印刷交易的「必要条款」，再查看双方后续行为。

examples.en: We asked which essential terms remained unresolved after reading both draft emails in the mock case.
examples.zh: 我们阅读模拟案例的两封草稿邮件后，考察还有哪些「必要条款」尚未确定。

words.enDefinition: Sufficient clarity in terms for obligations and the intended agreement to be identified under applicable law.

examples.en: The English law exercise raised certainty of terms when neither draft explained which equipment was included.
examples.zh: 两份草案都未说明包括哪些设备，因此英格兰合同法习题提出了「条款确定性」问题。

examples.en: We discussed certainty of terms while comparing two fictional clauses about the exhibition team's promised services.
examples.zh: 比较两项有关展览团队承诺服务的虚构条款时，我们讨论了「条款确定性」。

collocations: a question of certainty of terms

words.enDefinition: An agreement leaving one or more points for the parties to determine by further agreement.

examples.en: The tutor called the unresolved pricing clause an agreement to agree in the English law hypothetical.
examples.zh: 辅导老师把英格兰合同法假设案例中未确定的定价条款称为「约定日后商定」。

examples.en: We analyzed the agreement to agree after finding that the fictional parties had left the fee unsettled.
examples.zh: 我们发现虚构双方尚未敲定费用后，分析了这项「约定日后商定」。

collocations: a clause amounting to an agreement to agree
an agreement to agree on price

words.enDefinition: An event or requirement that must be satisfied before the proposed contract comes into existence.

examples.en: The mock draft treated committee approval as a condition to formation of the fictional exhibition contract.
examples.zh: 模拟草案将委员会批准列为虚构展览的「合同成立条件」。

examples.en: We distinguished a condition to formation from a requirement governing later performance in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂例题中，我们区分了「合同成立条件」与约束后续履行的要求。

words.enDefinition: An offer sufficiently clear for acceptance to establish an agreement under the applicable law.

examples.en: The mock judge looked for a definite offer before deciding whether the exchange could create a contract.
examples.zh: 模拟裁判者先查找是否有一项「确定的要约」，再判断该交流能否形成合同。

examples.en: In our classroom exercise, a definite offer identified the printed items and the proposed exchange in clear terms.
examples.zh: 在课堂练习中，一项「确定的要约」清楚写明了印刷物品和拟议的交换内容。

collocations: the terms of a definite offer

words.enDefinition: Something of legal value given or promised in exchange for a promise under applicable common law rules.

examples.en: The seminar asked what contractual consideration the fictional print shop received for its promise to supply posters.
examples.zh: 讨论课问，虚构印刷店承诺提供海报，换来的「合同对价」是什么。

examples.en: We highlighted contractual consideration on both sides of the exchange described in the American classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们用高亮标出美国课堂题所述交易双方提供的「合同对价」。

words.enDefinition: An exchange in which a promise, act, or forbearance is sought and given in return for another promise.

examples.en: The mock American opinion found a bargained-for exchange when each group promised something in return for the other.
examples.zh: 模拟美国判决意见认为，两组各自作出承诺以换取对方的承诺，构成「议定的交换」。

examples.en: We compared the bargained-for exchange in the fictional poster deal with the separate promise to give a gift.
examples.zh: 我们比较了虚构海报交易中的「议定的交换」与另行赠送礼物的承诺。

words.enDefinition: An act, forbearance, or promise restricting a legal freedom or undertaking something not already required.

examples.en: The American classroom opinion treated the promised surrender of a contractual right as a possible legal detriment.
examples.zh: 美国课堂判决示例把承诺放弃一项合同权利视为可能的「法律上的不利益」。

examples.en: We looked for a legal detriment in the exchanged promises rather than estimating the parties' financial losses.
examples.zh: 我们在互相交换的承诺中寻找「法律上的不利益」。

collocations: a legal detriment in an exchange

words.enDefinition: In consideration analysis, receipt of something to which the recipient was not already legally entitled.

examples.en: The American example used legal benefit to describe the promised service that the recipient could not otherwise demand.
examples.zh: 美国例题用「法律上的利益」描述一项约定服务，接受方原本无权要求该服务。

examples.en: We highlighted the legal benefit in the mock opinion by locating the new entitlement recognized by the court.
examples.zh: 我们找出模拟判决中裁判者认可的新权利，以标记「法律上的利益」。

collocations: a possible legal benefit to a party
a legal benefit in consideration analysis

words.enDefinition: Whether the promised exchange counts as consideration recognized by the applicable law.

examples.en: The English law worksheet discussed sufficiency of consideration before asking whether the classroom exchange seemed economically balanced.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法习题先讨论「对价的法律充分性」，再问课堂交易在经济上是否对等。

examples.en: We examined sufficiency of consideration by asking whether the promised act had legally recognized value in the problem.
examples.zh: 我们考察例题中承诺的行为是否有法律认可的价值，以分析「对价的法律充分性」。

collocations: a question about sufficiency of consideration
distinguish sufficiency of consideration from adequacy

words.enDefinition: The economic fairness or equivalence of the values exchanged as consideration.

examples.en: The seminar discussed adequacy of consideration after comparing the different values of the fictional items being exchanged.
examples.zh: 讨论课比较虚构交易物品的不同价值后，讨论了「对价的价值对等性」。

examples.en: We treated adequacy of consideration as a separate question from whether the mock exchange had legally recognized value.
examples.zh: 我们将「对价的价值对等性」与模拟交易是否存在法律认可的价值分开讨论。

collocations: an issue about adequacy of consideration
distinguish adequacy of consideration from sufficiency

words.enDefinition: A token amount or item stated as consideration, whose effect depends on the genuine bargain and applicable law.

examples.en: The fictional option mentioned nominal consideration, and the seminar asked whether it had actually been bargained for.
examples.zh: 虚构的期权安排写明「象征性对价」，讨论课问双方是否确实就它达成了交换。

examples.en: We distinguished an actual exchange of nominal consideration from a recital in the classroom document.
examples.zh: 我们区分了实际交换「象征性对价」与课堂文书中的一项记载。

collocations: a promise supported by nominal consideration

words.enDefinition: An earlier act or benefit offered as support for a promise made afterward, rather than in exchange for it.

examples.en: The fictional payment promise came after the favor, so the English worksheet raised a past consideration issue.
examples.zh: 虚构付款承诺发生在帮忙之后，因此英格兰合同法习题提出了「过去的对价」问题。

examples.en: We marked the dates in the hypothetical before deciding whether the earlier work counted as past consideration.
examples.zh: 我们先在假设案例中标出日期，再判断此前完成的工作是否属于「过去的对价」。

words.enDefinition: The traditional common law rule that doing what one already owes generally supplies no new consideration.

examples.en: The American common law exercise raised the pre-existing duty rule when the new promise repeated an existing obligation.
examples.zh: 新的承诺重复了一项已有义务，美国普通法习题因此提出「既存义务规则」问题。

examples.en: We compared the pre-existing duty rule in the services example with a separate goods provision in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上比较服务案例中的「既存义务规则」与货物买卖的一项专项规定。

collocations: discuss an exception to the pre-existing duty rule
a problem about the pre-existing duty rule

words.enDefinition: In a contract based on exchanged promises, the requirement that the promises actually bind the parties or that another basis for enforceability exists.

examples.en: The American case study questioned mutuality of obligation because one fictional group appeared free to do nothing.
examples.zh: 美国案例题质疑双方是否存在「义务相互约束」，因为虚构的一组似乎可以完全不作为。

examples.en: We traced both promises before discussing mutuality of obligation in the seminar's fictional agreement about exhibition supplies.
examples.zh: 讨论课分析虚构展览物资协议的「义务相互约束」前，我们先追踪双方各自的承诺。

collocations: an issue of mutuality of obligation
an argument about mutuality of obligation

words.enDefinition: An apparent commitment whose terms leave performance entirely to the supposed promisor's choice.

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the fictional promise of unlimited discretion amounted to an illusory promise under American law.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，虚构案例中由一方全权决定是否履行的承诺，在美国法下是否属于「虚幻承诺」。

examples.en: We looked at the limits on choice before classifying the response as an illusory promise in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们查看选择权是否有限制，再在习题中判断那条回复是否构成「虚幻承诺」。

collocations: a clause containing an illusory promise
distinguish an illusory promise from a commitment

words.enDefinition: A promise made without seeking a performance or return promise in exchange.

examples.en: In the classroom example, a gratuitous promise offered a book without asking the classmate for anything in exchange.
examples.zh: 课堂例题中的「无偿承诺」答应送一本书，未要求同学提供任何回报。

examples.en: The seminar compared the gratuitous promise with a second example involving an exchange of student club services.
examples.zh: 讨论课将「无偿承诺」与另一个涉及学生社团交换服务的例题作比较。

collocations: distinguish a gratuitous promise from a bargain

words.enDefinition: A gift that depends on an event not sought as the price of a promise.

examples.en: The mock problem called the free program a conditional gift because collection at the desk was required.
examples.zh: 模拟题把免费节目单视为「附条件赠与」，领取人必须到服务台取。

examples.en: We debated whether the fictional arrangement was a conditional gift or an exchange for a requested service.
examples.zh: 我们讨论这一虚构安排属于「附条件赠与」，还是用来换取指定服务的交易。

collocations: a promise of a conditional gift
distinguish a conditional gift from an exchange

words.enDefinition: An intention, assessed objectively in English contract law, for an agreement to have legal effect.

examples.en: The English worksheet asked whether the fictional parties showed an intention to create legal relations in their exchange.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法习题问，虚构双方是否在往来中表现出「设立法律关系的意图」。

examples.en: We examined the agreement's setting before discussing intention to create legal relations in the mock judgment.
examples.zh: 我们先分析协议订立的场合，再讨论模拟判决中的「设立法律关系的意图」。

collocations: show intention to create legal relations
assess intention to create legal relations
evidence of intention to create legal relations

words.enDefinition: An arrangement made in a family or household setting, often analyzed for contractual intention in English law.

examples.en: The English seminar used a fictional domestic agreement about sharing books to discuss the parties' legal intention.
examples.zh: 英格兰法律讨论课用一则家庭成员分享图书的虚构「家庭性协议」讨论当事人的法律约束意图。

examples.en: We compared the setting of a domestic agreement with the written arrangement between two student organizations.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「家庭性协议」的订立场合与两个学生组织的书面安排。

words.zhGloss: 商业协议法律意图推定
words.enDefinition: In English contract law, the rebuttable inference that parties in a commercial setting intend legal consequences.
acceptedZhAnswers: 商业协议法律意图推定

examples.en: The English classroom opinion considered the commercial presumption when two fictional campus suppliers exchanged written commitments.
examples.zh: 两家虚构校园供应商交换书面承诺时，英格兰课堂判决示例考虑了「商业协议法律意图推定」。

examples.en: We discussed whether the draft wording could rebut the commercial presumption in the fictional printing agreement.
examples.zh: 我们讨论虚构印刷协议草案中的措辞能否推翻「商业协议法律意图推定」。

words.enDefinition: The legal ability to enter a binding contract under the applicable rules.

examples.en: The instructor asked which facts mattered to legal capacity to contract in the fictional seminar problem.
examples.zh: 老师问，在讨论课的虚构题里，哪些事实与「缔约能力」有关。

examples.en: We treated legal capacity to contract as a separate issue from identifying the offer and acceptance.
examples.zh: 我们把「缔约能力」与识别要约、承诺分为不同问题。

collocations: an issue of legal capacity to contract

words.enDefinition: A minor's legal ability to enter a contract, subject to local rules and exceptions.

examples.en: The American exercise asked how local rules affected the contractual capacity of a minor in the fictional purchase.
examples.zh: 美国习题问，当地规则如何影响虚构购买案例中「未成年人的缔约能力」。

examples.en: We compared two classroom examples about the contractual capacity of a minor without assuming the rules were identical.
examples.zh: 我们对比了两道关于「未成年人的缔约能力」的课堂案例，留意其适用规则。

collocations: discuss the contractual capacity of a minor
an issue about the contractual capacity of a minor
a reading about the contractual capacity of a minor

words.enDefinition: A purpose or subject matter of an agreement permitted by the applicable law.

examples.en: The California classroom materials asked us to identify the lawful object of the fictional supply agreement.
examples.zh: 加利福尼亚州法课堂材料要求我们指出虚构供应协议的「合法的合同目的」。

examples.en: We discussed lawful object separately from whether both groups had agreed to the same terms in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「合法的合同目的」和双方是否同意同样的条款分开讨论。

collocations: the lawful object of an agreement
a requirement for a lawful object

words.enDefinition: An argument against enforcement because the agreement conflicts with a recognized legal public policy.

examples.en: The mock American judgment discussed a public policy defense before deciding whether the fictional promise was enforceable.
examples.zh: 模拟美国判决先考察「公共政策抗辩」，再判断法院能否认定虚构承诺可强制执行。

examples.en: We read the stated policy before analyzing the public policy defense in the seminar's fictional contract problem.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读指出的公共政策，再分析讨论课虚构合同题里的「公共政策抗辩」。

collocations: a public policy defense to enforcement

words.enDefinition: An apparent agreement treated as having no contractual legal effect from the outset under the applicable law.

examples.en: The mock opinion described a void contract as having no contractual effect from the beginning in that jurisdiction.
examples.zh: 模拟判决指出，在该司法辖区，「无效合同」从一开始就不发生合同效力。

examples.en: We asked why the classroom problem classified the fictional document as a void contract under the stated rule.
examples.zh: 我们问，课堂题为何按所给规则把这份虚构文书归为「无效合同」。

collocations: classify an agreement as a void contract
an issue involving a void contract
distinguish a void contract from a voidable one

words.enDefinition: A contract that has effect unless a party entitled to avoid it chooses to do so.

examples.en: The classroom case distinguished a voidable contract from an agreement that had no effect from the start.
examples.zh: 课堂案例区分了「可撤销合同」和从一开始就不发生效力的协议。

examples.en: We discussed who could avoid the voidable contract under the assumptions stated in the fictional problem.
examples.zh: 我们讨论在虚构题设下，谁有权撤销这份「可撤销合同」。

collocations: a party to a voidable contract
distinguish a voidable contract from a void agreement

words.enDefinition: An agreement to which a legal rule denies enforceability in the relevant circumstances.

examples.en: The fictional American opinion treated the missing formality as the reason for classifying an unenforceable agreement.
examples.zh: 模拟美国判决把形式要件欠缺作为认定「不可强制执行的协议」的理由。

examples.en: We discussed why the mock court called it an unenforceable agreement despite evidence that both parties had agreed.
examples.zh: 尽管有证据显示双方达成合意，模拟法院仍称它为「不可强制执行的协议」，我们讨论了原因。

collocations: classify an agreement as an unenforceable agreement
an action on an unenforceable agreement
the effect of an unenforceable agreement

words.enDefinition: A contract formed through an exchange of promises, with a commitment from both sides.

examples.en: The American worksheet illustrated a bilateral contract with both student clubs promising to provide something for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 美国课堂习题用两个学生社团均承诺给展览提供物品的例子说明「双务合同」。

examples.en: We found the two exchanged promises before labeling the fictional arrangement a bilateral contract in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先找出双方交换的两项承诺，再把虚构安排标为「双务合同」。

collocations: an example of a bilateral contract

words.enDefinition: In common law formation terminology, a contract in which an offer invites acceptance through a requested act.

examples.en: The American lecture used a fictional reward for a returned notebook to illustrate a unilateral contract.
examples.zh: 美国课堂用送回笔记本即可获得奖励的虚构例子说明「单务合同」。

examples.en: We identified the requested act before deciding whether the hypothetical offer described a unilateral contract in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先找出所要求的行为，再判断习题中的假设要约是否涉及「单务合同」。

collocations: an offer for a unilateral contract
an example of a unilateral contract

words.enDefinition: An agreement whose formation is shown through explicit written or spoken words.

examples.en: The mock case called the spoken agreement an express contract because both parties stated their commitments openly.
examples.zh: 模拟案例把口头协议称为「明示合同」，因为双方都明确说出了各自的承诺。

examples.en: We read the message exchange as possible evidence of an express contract in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 在课堂题中，我们把这些来往消息视为可能证明存在「明示合同」的证据。

collocations: the words of an express contract

words.enDefinition: An actual agreement inferred from the parties' conduct and circumstances rather than explicitly stated in words.

examples.en: The American hypothetical asked whether the groups' behavior supported a contract implied in fact about the display materials.
examples.zh: 美国假设案例问，各组的行为能否证明双方就展品材料达成了「事实默示合同」。

examples.en: We examined the conduct in the fictional record before discussing whether it demonstrated a contract implied in fact.
examples.zh: 我们考察虚构记录中的行为，再讨论它是否表明存在一份「事实默示合同」。

collocations: find a contract implied in fact
facts supporting a contract implied in fact
an example of a contract implied in fact

words.enDefinition: An incorrect belief at the time of agreement that may matter under the applicable contract rules.

examples.en: The seminar raised contractual mistake after finding that both fictional groups had assumed the same room was available.
examples.zh: 我们发现虚构的两组都以为同一房间可用后，讨论课提出了「缔约错误」问题。

examples.en: We compared two forms of contractual mistake before reading the mock court's conclusion about the agreement.
examples.zh: 我们先比较两种「缔约错误」，再读模拟法院对该协议的结论。

collocations: assess a claim of contractual mistake

words.enDefinition: In United States contract law, a shared mistaken belief about a basic assumption underlying the agreement.

examples.en: The American classroom case illustrated mutual mistake when both fictional parties were wrong about the same existing fact.
examples.zh: 美国课堂案例中，虚构双方都误以为同一项既存事实属实，以此说明「双方共同错误」。

examples.en: We checked the parties' messages for evidence of mutual mistake in the fictional agreement about the exhibit materials.
examples.zh: 我们查看双方的来往消息，在关于展品材料的虚构协议中寻找「双方共同错误」的证据。

collocations: a claim based on mutual mistake

words.enDefinition: A mistaken belief held by only one party when the parties entered into an agreement.

examples.en: The seminar identified unilateral mistake because only one fictional party misunderstood the quantity in the proposal.
examples.zh: 讨论课认定存在「单方错误」，因为只有一方误解了虚构提议中的数量。

examples.en: We looked separately at what each party believed before discussing unilateral mistake in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 讨论课堂案例中的「单方错误」前，我们分别查看了双方各自相信的情况。

words.enDefinition: A false or misleading preagreement representation alleged to have induced entry into the contract.

examples.en: The mock opinion addressed precontractual misrepresentation after one fictional party relied on an inaccurate description of exhibit space.
examples.zh: 一方依赖了对展览场地的不实描述后，模拟判决考察了「缔约前虚假陈述」问题。

examples.en: We distinguished precontractual misrepresentation from the commitments in the final written agreement in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 课堂题中，我们区分了「缔约前虚假陈述」与最终书面协议中的承诺。

words.enDefinition: Improper pressure that leaves a party without a reasonable alternative to apparent agreement under applicable rules.

examples.en: The seminar discussed duress in contract law when reading the fictional court's account of pressure during negotiations.
examples.zh: 讨论课阅读虚构法院对协商压力的叙述时，讨论了「合同法上的胁迫」。

examples.en: We distinguished ordinary bargaining pressure from duress in contract law in the hypothetical opinion our tutor supplied.
examples.zh: 辅导老师给出的假设判决意见中，我们区分了普通议价压力与「合同法上的胁迫」。

collocations: an allegation of duress in contract law
the concept of duress in contract law
a classroom example of duress in contract law

words.enDefinition: Improper use of influence or a relationship of trust that undermines a party's free decision to agree.

examples.en: The mock English judgment considered undue influence when discussing how trust affected the fictional party's apparent agreement.
examples.zh: 模拟英格兰判决在讨论信任如何影响虚构当事人表面同意时，考察了「不当影响」。

examples.en: We highlighted the facts about the relationship before discussing undue influence in our seminar's fictional contract problem.
examples.zh: 讨论课分析虚构合同题里的「不当影响」之前，我们先标出了有关双方关系的事实。

words.enDefinition: Extreme unfairness in a contract or term that can affect enforceability under applicable United States law.

examples.en: The New York classroom exercise asked about unconscionability in a fictional goods agreement with a sharply one-sided term.
examples.zh: 纽约州课堂习题就一份条款明显偏向一方的虚构货物协议，提出了「显失公平」问题。

examples.en: We read the mock court's discussion of unconscionability before comparing the agreement's terms and formation circumstances.
examples.zh: 对照协议条款与订立情形前，我们先读了模拟法院对「显失公平」的讨论。

words.enDefinition: In United States law, extreme unfairness tied to how a contract was presented, negotiated, or agreed to.

examples.en: The American worksheet discussed procedural unconscionability by asking whether the fictional party could meaningfully review the proposed terms.
examples.zh: 美国习题考察虚构当事人能否充分审阅拟议条款，以讨论「程序上的显失公平」。

examples.en: We separated the facts about the signing process when assessing procedural unconscionability in the mock case.
examples.zh: 我们把签署过程的事实单列出来，以评估模拟案例中的「程序上的显失公平」。

words.enDefinition: In United States law, extreme unfairness in the substance or effects of the contract terms.

examples.en: The mock opinion discussed substantive unconscionability after describing how the clause placed almost every burden on one side.
examples.zh: 模拟判决先说明该条款如何将几乎所有负担施加给一方，再讨论「实质上的显失公平」。

examples.en: We examined the terms themselves before considering substantive unconscionability in the American classroom case study.
examples.zh: 在考察美国课堂案例中的「实质上的显失公平」之前，我们先阅读条款本身。

words.enDefinition: Agreement given freely and based on a sufficient understanding under the applicable rules of consent.

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the fictional record showed genuine assent given the party's account of the negotiations.
examples.zh: 考虑到当事人对协商经过的叙述，辅导老师问虚构记录是否表明存在「真实同意」。

examples.en: We identified a genuine assent issue even though the classroom file contained a signed page from both groups.
examples.zh: 尽管课堂档案中有双方签署的页面，我们仍识别出一个「真实同意」问题。

words.enDefinition: Later confirmation of a prior agreement by someone whom the law permits to adopt or reject it.

examples.en: The fictional opinion discussed ratification of a contract after the person later confirmed an earlier agreement.
examples.zh: 虚构判决在当事人后来确认先前的协议后，讨论了「合同追认」问题。

examples.en: We separated ratification of a contract from the original signature on the timeline of the classroom case.
examples.zh: 在课堂案例的时间线上，我们把「合同追认」与最初的签署分开标出。

collocations: an act of ratification of a contract
evidence of ratification of a contract

words.enDefinition: An agreement whose terms are recorded in writing as the parties' contract.

examples.en: The classroom file contained a written contract listing the fictional exhibition dates and shared room details.
examples.zh: 课堂档案里有一份「书面合同」，列出虚构展览的日期和共用场地细节。

examples.en: We compared the written contract with the earlier correspondence to see which points the document covered.
examples.zh: 我们把「书面合同」与早期往来记录对照，查看文书涵盖了哪些事项。

collocations: the terms of a written contract

words.enDefinition: An agreement made through spoken words that can have contractual effect under the applicable law.

examples.en: In the mock case, two fictional witnesses recalled different terms of the alleged oral contract.
examples.zh: 在模拟案例中，两位虚构证人对所主张的「口头合同」条款有不同的回忆。

examples.en: We discussed evidence of an oral contract after reading the classroom transcript of the parties' conversation.
examples.zh: 我们阅读双方对话的课堂模拟记录后，讨论了「口头合同」的证据。

collocations: the terms of an oral contract

words.enDefinition: In English law, a contract made without using the form of a deed.

examples.en: The English worksheet classified the fictional printing agreement as a simple contract made through written messages.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法习题把虚构印刷协议归为通过书面消息订立的「非契据合同」。

examples.en: We compared a simple contract with a deed in the two classroom examples about legal form.
examples.zh: 在关于法律形式的两个课堂示例中，我们对比了「非契据合同」和契据。

collocations: distinguish a simple contract from a deed

words.enDefinition: In English law, a contract embodied in a document given legal effect as a deed.

examples.en: The English materials labeled the classroom instrument a contract by deed and asked about its legal form.
examples.zh: 英格兰法律材料把课堂文书标为「契据合同」，并请我们识别其法律形式。

examples.en: We found the wording identifying the contract by deed on the first page of the fictional document.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构文书的第一页找到了将其标明为「契据合同」的措辞。

collocations: a contract by deed under English law

words.enDefinition: In English law, an act signifying intention to be bound by a deed, sometimes subject to a condition.

examples.en: The English seminar discussed delivery of a deed after separating the signature from the intended time of commitment.
examples.zh: 讨论课区分签署与当事人有意受约束的时间之后，讨论了英格兰法中的「契据交付」。

examples.en: We noted that delivery of a deed concerned legal intention in the fictional case discussed in class.
examples.zh: 我们指出，课堂虚构案例中的「契据交付」涉及当事人的法律意图。

collocations: the timing of delivery of a deed
an issue of delivery of a deed

words.enDefinition: A written record evidencing an agreement, which may satisfy a form requirement under applicable law.

examples.en: The mock American opinion asked whether a message served as a written memorandum of a contract for goods.
examples.zh: 模拟美国判决问，一则消息是否可作为货物合同的「书面备忘记录」。

examples.en: We compared the written memorandum of a contract with the agreement described in the classroom conversation transcript.
examples.zh: 我们将「合同书面备忘记录」与课堂对话记录中描述的协议作了比较。

collocations: identify a written memorandum of a contract
details in a written memorandum of a contract
a signed written memorandum of a contract

words.enDefinition: A United States legal rule requiring written evidence for enforcement of certain agreements, subject to applicable exceptions.
acceptedZhAnswers: 防止欺诈法上的书面要求

examples.en: The American class considered whether the statute of frauds applied to the fictional agreement for supplying exhibition materials.
examples.zh: 美国课堂考察「防止欺诈法上的书面要求」是否适用于这份供应展览材料的虚构协议。

examples.en: We drew a separate column for the statute of frauds issue in our mock case outline.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟案例提纲中，为「防止欺诈法上的书面要求」问题单列了一栏。

words.enDefinition: A legal form requirement calling for a signed written record for specified agreements or terms.

examples.en: The fictional New York case asked whether a signed writing requirement applied to the record before the court.
examples.zh: 虚构纽约州案例考察，「签署书面文件的要求」是否适用于法院审查的记录。

examples.en: We identified the signed writing requirement before comparing the documents supplied in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「签署书面文件的要求」，再比较课堂题所给的文书。

collocations: an exception to a signed writing requirement

words.enDefinition: A separately signed copy of the same contract that forms part of one signed agreement.

examples.en: The tutor identified each contract counterpart by matching the text across both signed classroom copies.
examples.zh: 辅导老师对照课堂两份已签副本的文本，辨认各份「合同签署副本」。

examples.en: We treated the second contract counterpart as part of the same fictional agreement about the exhibition.
examples.zh: 我们把第二份「合同签署副本」视为同一份虚构展览协议的一部分。

words.enDefinition: An introductory statement setting out the background or purpose of an agreement.

examples.en: The first contract recital explained why the fictional student groups planned to share exhibition materials.
examples.zh: 第一项「合同背景陈述」解释了虚构学生团体为何打算共享展览材料。

examples.en: We marked the contract recital before reading the later provisions about the parties' agreed commitments.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「合同背景陈述」，再读后面的双方承诺条款。

collocations: the wording of a contract recital

words.enDefinition: A contract provision explaining the meanings assigned to selected words or expressions in the agreement.

examples.en: The definitions clause explained what the fictional agreement meant by its shortened name for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 「定义条款」说明虚构协议中展览简称所指的内容。

examples.en: We checked the definitions clause before using any of the capitalized terms in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 使用课堂题里的任何大写术语之前，我们先查看了「定义条款」。

collocations: a meaning given in a definitions clause

words.enDefinition: A word or expression assigned a specific meaning by the contract text.

examples.en: We found the defined term in the opening section before reading its use in the schedule.
examples.zh: 我们先在开头部分找到这个「经定义的术语」，再读它在附表中的用法。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the same defined term referred to all posters in the fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，在虚构协议中，同一个「经定义的术语」是否指全部海报。

collocations: a defined term used in a clause

words.enDefinition: A provision that sets out a legal right, obligation, or other substantive effect of the agreement.

examples.en: The operative clause set out which fictional club would provide the printed programs for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 「合同权利义务条款」列明哪一个虚构社团为展览提供印制的节目单。

examples.en: We matched the operative clause to the promise discussed in the mock court's explanation of the text.
examples.zh: 我们把「合同权利义务条款」与模拟法院解释文本时讨论的承诺对应起来。

collocations: an operative clause of a contract

words.enDefinition: A contractual term stated explicitly by the parties in writing or speech.

examples.en: The mock agreement gave the exhibition date as an express term in the first numbered clause.
examples.zh: 模拟协议在第一项编号条款中把展览日期列为「明示条款」。

examples.en: We read the express term before discussing whether the fictional contract left any point unstated.
examples.zh: 讨论虚构合同是否还有未明说的事项前，我们先读了「明示条款」。

collocations: an express term of the contract

words.enDefinition: A term that becomes part of a contract under applicable legal rules without being expressly stated.

examples.en: The fictional opinion considered an implied term after finding that the written clauses left the point unanswered.
examples.zh: 发现成文条款没回答该问题后，虚构判决考察了可能的「默示条款」。

examples.en: We discussed an implied term alongside the exact words in the classroom's English contract law example.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂英格兰合同法示例中，将一项「默示条款」与合同原文一并讨论。

collocations: an implied term of a contract

words.enDefinition: An unstated term inferred for a particular contract from its wording and circumstances under applicable law.

examples.en: The English exercise asked whether the fictional agreement required a term implied in fact to operate coherently.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法练习问，是否需要一项「依事实默示的条款」，虚构协议才能合理运作。

examples.en: We drew the case facts beside the proposed term implied in fact in the classroom hypothetical.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂假设案例中，把案件事实列在拟议的「依事实默示的条款」旁边。

collocations: identify a term implied in fact
argue for a term implied in fact
a proposed term implied in fact

words.enDefinition: A term supplied by law for a category of contracts, rather than inferred only from this bargain.

examples.en: The classroom problem asked whether a term implied by law applied to the fictional agreement's category.
examples.zh: 课堂题考察一项「依法默示的条款」是否适用于这份虚构协议所属的合同类别。

examples.en: We read the relevant legal extract before identifying the term implied by law in the English exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先读相关法律节选，再确定英格兰法练习中的「依法默示的条款」。

collocations: identify a term implied by law
a default term implied by law
the source of a term implied by law

words.enDefinition: Making an external document or provision part of a contract through a reference that the law recognizes.

examples.en: The mock agreement illustrated incorporation by reference by naming a separate document containing the exhibition details.
examples.zh: 模拟协议写明载有展览细节的另一份文件，以说明「引用并入」。

examples.en: We followed the cross-reference in the draft before discussing incorporation by reference in our classroom case.
examples.zh: 在讨论课堂案例中的「引用并入」之前，我们沿着草案中的交叉引用查找相关文件。

collocations: an issue of incorporation by reference
incorporation by reference of a schedule

words.enDefinition: Provisions drawn into a contract from another source under the applicable rules.

examples.en: The classroom draft pointed to a schedule containing the incorporated terms for the fictional exhibition agreement.
examples.zh: 课堂草案指向一份附表，里面有虚构展览协议「并入的条款」。

examples.en: We checked which incorporated terms the mock opinion treated as part of the parties' actual agreement.
examples.zh: 我们查看了模拟判决将哪些「并入的条款」视为双方实际协议的一部分。

words.enDefinition: In United States usage, a standardized contract offered without meaningful opportunity to negotiate its terms.

examples.en: The American exercise asked whether the fictional campus form qualified as a contract of adhesion.
examples.zh: 美国课堂题问，虚构的校园表格是否属于「附合合同」。

examples.en: We read the facts about possible negotiations before classifying the document as a contract of adhesion.
examples.zh: 在把文书归类为「附合合同」之前，我们先阅读了有无协商机会的事实。

collocations: a potentially one-sided contract of adhesion

words.enDefinition: A conventional provision reused across contracts, often addressing procedural or structural matters.

examples.en: We identified a boilerplate clause that appeared unchanged in both versions of the fictional exhibition agreement.
examples.zh: 我们认出一项「通用模板条款」，在虚构展览协议的两个版本中完全相同。

examples.en: The tutor asked what the boilerplate clause meant in context before discussing the classroom agreement's main terms.
examples.zh: 讨论课堂协议的主要条款前，辅导老师问「通用模板条款」在这里是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: In United States contract law, a writing adopted as the complete and final statement of the parties' agreement.

examples.en: The American worksheet asked whether the fictional text was a fully integrated agreement covering the whole exchange.
examples.zh: 美国课堂题问，这份虚构文本是不是涵盖整个交易的「完全整合的协议」。

examples.en: We read the mock court's explanation of why the writing counted as a fully integrated agreement.
examples.zh: 我们阅读模拟法院的说明，理解为何这份书面文书属于「完全整合的协议」。

collocations: treat a writing as a fully integrated agreement
evidence of a fully integrated agreement

words.enDefinition: In United States contract law, a writing final for some terms but not intended as the complete agreement.

examples.en: The American hypothetical treated the short signed list as a partially integrated agreement about only some matters.
examples.zh: 美国假设案例把这份简短的签署清单视为仅涵盖部分事项的「部分整合的协议」。

examples.en: We considered which topics remained open after reading the partially integrated agreement in the classroom file.
examples.zh: 我们阅读课堂档案中的「部分整合的协议」后，考察哪些事项仍未写入。

collocations: a term in a partially integrated agreement

words.enDefinition: The ranking of contract documents used to decide which controls when provisions conflict.

examples.en: The contract document hierarchy in our exercise ranked the main text above the attached programme schedule.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中的「合同文件优先顺序」将正文列在所附活动安排表之前。

examples.en: We checked the contract document hierarchy after finding different dates in two fictional exhibition documents.
examples.zh: 发现两份虚构展览文件的日期不一致后，我们核对了「合同文件优先顺序」。

collocations: apply the contract document hierarchy in a classroom example

words.enDefinition: A contract provision specifying which listed terms or documents control if they conflict.

examples.en: The order of precedence clause identified which classroom document would control if two listed dates differed.
examples.zh: 「文件优先顺序条款」说明两处所载日期不同时以哪份课堂文件为准。

examples.en: We underlined the order of precedence clause before comparing the wording of the attachment and main text.
examples.zh: 我们先在「文件优先顺序条款」下划线，再对照附件和正文的措辞。

collocations: read an order of precedence clause
interpret an order of precedence clause
a conflict covered by an order of precedence clause

words.enDefinition: A provision identifying the law chosen to govern interpretation or other matters under the contract.

examples.en: The governing law clause named English law in the fictional exhibition supply agreement used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的虚构展览物资协议在「法律适用条款」中指定了英格兰法。

examples.en: We found the governing law clause before reading the mock opinion's discussion of how to interpret the text.
examples.zh: 阅读模拟判决关于如何解释文本的讨论前，我们先找到了「法律适用条款」。

collocations: the jurisdiction named in a governing law clause

words.enDefinition: A provision stating that contract changes must be made in a specified form rather than orally.

examples.en: The tutor pointed to the no oral modification clause before showing the fictional parties' later conversation.
examples.zh: 辅导老师先指出「禁止口头变更条款」，再展示虚构双方后来的谈话。

examples.en: We copied the wording of the no oral modification clause into our classroom outline about contract form.
examples.zh: 我们将「禁止口头变更条款」的措辞抄到课堂的合同形式提纲中。

collocations: read a no oral modification clause
a contract containing a no oral modification clause
interpret a no oral modification clause

words.enDefinition: A communication or display making proposed contractual terms available to the other party.

examples.en: The mock opinion asked when notice of terms occurred before the student club agreed to the arrangement.
examples.zh: 模拟判决问，在学生社团同意此安排之前，何时作出了「条款告知」。

examples.en: We compared two fictional screens to see what notice of terms the other party would have received.
examples.zh: 我们比较两个虚构页面，查看对方当时可能收到什么「条款告知」。

words.zhGloss: 消费者合同条款透明性
words.enDefinition: The United Kingdom consumer law requirement for written terms to be legible and expressed in plain, intelligible language.
acceptedZhAnswers: 消费者合同条款透明性

examples.en: The seminar used two fictional notices to discuss transparency of consumer terms under the United Kingdom reading.
examples.zh: 讨论课用两则虚构通知，分析英国法律阅读材料中的「消费者合同条款透明性」。

examples.en: We reviewed the wording and readability when discussing transparency of consumer terms in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 讨论课堂例题中的「消费者合同条款透明性」时，我们查看了措辞及可读性。

collocations: a rule on transparency of consumer terms
an issue of transparency of consumer terms

words.enDefinition: An attached part of a contract that sets out details such as dates, items, or specifications.

examples.en: The contract schedule listed the fictional exhibition rooms and corresponding dates in a separate table.
examples.zh: 「合同附表」在一张单独的表里列出了虚构展览各房间和相应日期。

examples.en: We checked the contract schedule after finding a short reference to it in the main agreement.
examples.zh: 我们在主协议看到一处简短引用后，查阅了「合同附表」。

collocations: a date in a contract schedule
include details in a contract schedule

words.enDefinition: Determining the meaning of a contract and its provisions under the applicable legal approach.

examples.en: The seminar used contractual interpretation to explain why a disputed phrase changed meaning when read in context.
examples.zh: 讨论课运用「合同解释」说明为什么结合上下文阅读时，争议短语的含义发生变化。

examples.en: We separated contractual interpretation from assessing whether the fictional student groups had made an agreement at all.
examples.zh: 我们将「合同解释」与判断虚构学生团体是否达成协议分开分析。

words.enDefinition: The meaning a word or phrase normally has in its relevant linguistic context.

examples.en: The mock court considered the ordinary meaning of a term before examining the rest of the clause.
examples.zh: 模拟法院先考虑「术语的通常含义」，再看该条款的其余部分。

examples.en: We discussed the ordinary meaning of a term and checked whether the fictional agreement expressly defined it differently.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「术语的通常含义」，并核对虚构协议是否另行作了明确定义。

collocations: consider the ordinary meaning of a term
determine the ordinary meaning of a term
start with the ordinary meaning of a term

words.enDefinition: An interpretive approach that gives controlling weight to clear contractual text where the applicable law calls for it.

examples.en: The mock American opinion applied the plain meaning rule after finding the disputed classroom wording unambiguous.
examples.zh: 模拟美国判决认定课堂案例中有争议的措辞明确后，适用了「清楚文义规则」。

examples.en: We compared the plain meaning rule in the assigned opinion with a different interpretive approach in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把指定判决中的「清楚文义规则」与另一种解释方法作比较。

collocations: the limits of the plain meaning rule

words.enDefinition: An interpretive approach that focuses on the wording and structure of the contract.

examples.en: The tutor used textual interpretation to explain how the sentence's grammar supported one reading of the draft.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「文本解释」说明句子的语法如何支持对草案的一种理解。

examples.en: We examined the clause's punctuation and structure when practicing textual interpretation in the fictional contract dispute.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构合同争议中练习「文本解释」，检查条款的标点与结构。

collocations: an argument based on textual interpretation
a textual interpretation of a clause

words.enDefinition: An interpretive approach that considers the contract's words in their textual and relevant factual setting.

examples.en: The English law exercise used contextual interpretation to relate the disputed wording to the wider agreement.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法练习运用「语境解释」，考察争议措辞与协议整体之间的关系。

examples.en: We discussed contextual interpretation after reading the fictional contract alongside the circumstances known to both parties.
examples.zh: 把虚构合同与双方都知道的相关情形一起阅读后，我们讨论了「语境解释」。

collocations: a contextual interpretation of a clause
consider contextual interpretation in a case

words.expression: read the contract as a whole
words.lemma: read the contract as a whole
words.enDefinition: To interpret a provision in relation to the rest of the contract rather than in isolation.
acceptedEnVariants: read the contract as a whole

examples.en: The tutor asked us to read the contract as a whole before assigning meaning to one sentence.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们先「整体解读合同」，再判断某句话的含义。

examples.en: We had to read the contract as a whole in the fictional disagreement about the shared room.
examples.zh: 在这道关于共用房间的虚构争议题里，我们需要「整体解读合同」。

collocations: read the contract as a whole before construing a clause
invited to read the contract as a whole
asked to read the contract as a whole

words.enDefinition: Practical business considerations that can help assess plausible interpretations in English contract law.

examples.en: The English mock judgment used commercial common sense to compare two readings that the wording could support.
examples.zh: 模拟英格兰判决运用「商业常识」，比较措辞能支持的两种理解。

examples.en: We discussed commercial common sense after tracing how each interpretation would affect the fictional printing arrangement.
examples.zh: 我们分析每种解释对虚构印刷安排的影响后，讨论了「商业常识」。

collocations: an argument based on commercial common sense

words.enDefinition: The meaning that a reasonable reader with the relevant background would attribute to the parties' words.

examples.en: The fictional English opinion asked about the objective meaning of the clause in its agreed setting.
examples.zh: 虚构的英格兰判决讨论条款在双方共同背景下的「客观含义」。

examples.en: We separated objective meaning from one party's private understanding in the classroom's contract interpretation problem.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂合同解释题中，区分了「客观含义」与一方私下的理解。

collocations: the objective meaning of a provision

words.enDefinition: The background facts reasonably available to the parties when contracting that may inform interpretation under English law.

examples.en: The seminar limited the factual matrix to circumstances both fictional groups could reasonably have known at formation.
examples.zh: 讨论课把「相关事实背景」限于虚构双方订立合同时本可以合理知悉的情形。

examples.en: We noted which background facts belonged to the factual matrix before interpreting the classroom's English agreement.
examples.zh: 解释课堂示例中的英格兰法协议前，我们先记录哪些事实属于「相关事实背景」。

collocations: interpret a clause in light of the factual matrix

words.enDefinition: Material outside the contract text offered to help establish its meaning, scope, or formation.

examples.en: The mock American court considered extrinsic evidence after reading the disputed provision in the fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 模拟美国法院阅读虚构协议中有争议的条款后，考虑了「合同文本之外的证据」。

examples.en: We sorted the documents into contract text and extrinsic evidence before discussing their different classroom uses.
examples.zh: 我们将材料分为合同文本与「合同文本之外的证据」，再讨论课堂题中的不同用途。

words.enDefinition: The exchanges and discussions preceding formation of a possible contract.

examples.en: We separated precontractual negotiations from the final signed text in the fictional exchange about the exhibition.
examples.zh: 在关于展览的虚构往来中，我们区分了「缔约前磋商」和最终签署的文本。

examples.en: The tutor asked how the jurisdiction in the problem treated precontractual negotiations as evidence of meaning.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，题设司法辖区如何看待以「缔约前磋商」作为证明文义的证据。

words.enDefinition: A United States doctrine limiting use of prior agreements or contemporaneous oral agreements to contradict a final writing.

examples.en: The mock American opinion discussed the parol evidence rule after finding that the written text was final.
examples.zh: 模拟美国判决认定书面文本是最终版本后，讨论了「口头证据规则」。

examples.en: We compared the parol evidence rule with the separate question of whether the classroom agreement was complete.
examples.zh: 我们将「口头证据规则」与课堂协议是否完整这一独立问题联系起来比较。

collocations: an exception to the parol evidence rule
the scope of the parol evidence rule

words.enDefinition: A regularly observed practice in a trade that may inform the meaning of an agreement.

examples.en: The New York goods exercise considered a trade usage when interpreting a term about standard poster sizes.
examples.zh: 纽约州货物买卖练习解释有关常用海报尺寸的条款时，考察了一项「行业惯例」。

examples.en: We asked what evidence of trade usage existed beyond one party's own practice in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 我们考察，在虚构案例中，除一方自己的做法外，还有什么证据能证明「行业惯例」。

collocations: interpret a term in light of trade usage

words.enDefinition: A pattern from prior transactions between the same parties that may establish a shared understanding.

examples.en: The New York hypothetical used course of dealing to discuss how the parties understood an abbreviated label.
examples.zh: 纽约州假设题通过「以往交易惯例」讨论双方如何理解一个缩写标签。

examples.en: We examined several earlier transactions before identifying a possible course of dealing in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 课堂题中，我们考察了此前的几次交易，再辨认可能存在的「以往交易惯例」。

collocations: evidence of a course of dealing

words.zhGloss: 本合同的实际履行惯例
words.enDefinition: In UCC usage, repeated conduct under the same transaction when the other party knows its nature and accepts it or acquiesces without objection.
acceptedZhAnswers: 本合同的实际履行惯例

examples.en: The New York goods worksheet asked whether repeated conduct under one agreement established a course of performance.
examples.zh: 纽约州货物买卖习题问，同一协议下反复发生的行为是否形成「本合同的实际履行惯例」。

examples.en: We distinguished course of performance under the current fictional agreement from exchanges arising under earlier agreements.
examples.zh: 我们区分了当前虚构协议中的「本合同的实际履行惯例」与此前协议下的交易。

collocations: evidence from a course of performance
interpret terms using course of performance

words.enDefinition: Additional terms that do not contradict a final writing and may supplement it under applicable United States law.

examples.en: The New York exercise asked whether consistent additional terms could supplement the classroom's final but incomplete writing.
examples.zh: 纽约州练习问，「相容的补充条款」能否补充课堂案例中最终但不完整的书面文书。

examples.en: We examined the text before classifying the alleged additions as consistent additional terms in the fictional dispute.
examples.zh: 我们先审阅文本，再判断虚构争议中所称的增订内容是否属于「相容的补充条款」。

collocations: admit evidence of consistent additional terms
a dispute about consistent additional terms

words.enDefinition: An oral agreement made at about the time the parties adopt a written agreement.

examples.en: The American worksheet asked whether a contemporaneous oral agreement contradicted the final wording in the fictional contract.
examples.zh: 美国习题问，一份「同期口头协议」是否与虚构合同的最终措辞相矛盾。

examples.en: We placed the contemporaneous oral agreement alongside the signed writing on the timeline of the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂题的时间线上把「同期口头协议」与已签署的书面文书并排标出。

collocations: evidence of a contemporaneous oral agreement
a dispute about a contemporaneous oral agreement

words.enDefinition: Contract wording capable of more than one reasonable interpretation under the applicable legal approach.

examples.en: The tutor identified ambiguity in a contract when two plausible readings of the classroom phrase became apparent.
examples.zh: 课堂短语出现两种合理理解时，辅导老师识别出「合同中的歧义」。

examples.en: We discussed whether ambiguity in a contract arose from the word after reading the full sentence.
examples.zh: 我们看过完整句子后，讨论这个词是否造成了「合同中的歧义」。

collocations: a dispute involving ambiguity in a contract

words.enDefinition: An ambiguity apparent from the wording of a document itself.

examples.en: The fictional opinion called the conflict between two dates on the same page a patent ambiguity.
examples.zh: 虚构判决将同一页上两个日期之间的冲突称为「表面歧义」。

examples.en: We found a patent ambiguity before consulting any information outside the wording supplied in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们尚未查阅练习所给措辞之外的信息，就发现了「表面歧义」。

collocations: an example of a patent ambiguity
a provision containing a patent ambiguity

words.enDefinition: An ambiguity that becomes apparent when otherwise clear wording is applied to external facts.

examples.en: The fictional room name appeared clear until two rooms shared it, revealing a latent ambiguity in the exercise.
examples.zh: 虚构地点名称原本看似明确，得知两间房同名后，习题里的「潜在歧义」才显现出来。

examples.en: We discussed latent ambiguity after connecting the apparently straightforward clause to the classroom map of the venue.
examples.zh: 我们将看似简单明了的条款与课堂场馆地图联系起来后，讨论了「潜在歧义」。

collocations: an example of a latent ambiguity

words.zhGloss: 作不利于条款提供方的解释
words.enDefinition: Where applicable, construing unresolved ambiguity against the party that supplied the disputed wording.
acceptedZhAnswers: 作不利于条款提供方的解释

examples.en: The mock judgment considered contra proferentem after finding two plausible readings of the provision drafted by one party.
examples.zh: 模拟判决发现一方拟定的条款有两种合理理解后，考察是否「作不利于条款提供方的解释」。

examples.en: We discussed contra proferentem as one possible interpretive principle in the fictional classroom dispute over an ambiguous provision.
examples.zh: 我们把「作不利于条款提供方的解释」作为课堂虚构条款歧义争议中的一种可能原则来讨论。

words.enDefinition: A canon under which general words following specific examples may be limited to the same class.

examples.en: The class used ejusdem generis to ask whether general words covered things unlike the earlier listed items.
examples.zh: 我们用「同类解释规则」考察概括性措辞是否涵盖与前列项目不同类的事物。

examples.en: We identified the common class in the fictional materials list before considering ejusdem generis in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们先在虚构材料清单中找出共同类别，再考虑「同类解释规则」。

collocations: a classroom example of ejusdem generis

words.enDefinition: A canon interpreting a word in light of the words associated with it in the same passage.

examples.en: The tutor used noscitur a sociis to ask how nearby words affected the disputed term in the draft.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「依相邻词语理解词义」这一规则，考察邻近措辞怎样影响草案中的争议术语。

examples.en: We applied noscitur a sociis by examining the company the disputed word kept in the classroom sentence.
examples.zh: 我们查看课堂句子中哪些词与争议词并列，以运用「依相邻词语理解词义」的规则。

words.zhGloss: 具体条款优先于一般条款
words.enDefinition: An interpretive principle giving more specific language priority over conflicting general language where applicable.
acceptedZhAnswers: 具体条款优先于一般条款

examples.en: The tutor explained why specific terms control general terms in the classroom draft involving two conflicting provisions.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释，在有两项条款冲突的课堂草案中，为何适用「具体条款优先于一般条款」。

examples.en: We asked whether specific terms control general terms when both clauses addressed delivery in the mock case.
examples.zh: 在模拟案例中，两项条款都涉及交付，我们考察是否应适用「具体条款优先于一般条款」。

collocations: apply the principle that specific terms control general terms
the canon that specific terms control general terms
consider whether specific terms control general terms

words.enDefinition: To read provisions together in a way that gives them consistent effect when reasonably possible.

examples.en: The class tried to harmonize contract terms before deciding whether the two descriptions of delivery were inconsistent.
examples.zh: 我们先尝试「协调解释合同条款」，再判断两处关于交付的描述是否相互矛盾。

examples.en: We discussed how to harmonize contract terms by reading the schedule with the main text in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在习题中，我们把附表与正文一起读，讨论怎样「协调解释合同条款」。

collocations: harmonize contract terms before finding a conflict

words.zhGloss: 避免将措辞解释为多余
words.enDefinition: To favor an interpretation that gives useful effect to each part of the text when reasonably possible.
acceptedZhAnswers: 避免将措辞解释为多余

examples.en: We tried to avoid surplusage by asking whether each phrase did separate work in the fictional clause.
examples.zh: 我们考察虚构条款的各个短语是否各自发挥作用，以「避免将措辞解释为多余」。

examples.en: The mock court tried to avoid surplusage when comparing two possible readings of the classroom agreement.
examples.zh: 模拟法院比较课堂协议的两种可能理解时，力求「避免将措辞解释为多余」。

collocations: interpret a clause to avoid surplusage
try to avoid surplusage in interpretation

words.enDefinition: Practical coherence of a bargain, considered when English law asks whether an unstated term is necessary.

examples.en: The English seminar used business efficacy to ask whether the fictional bargain made practical sense without another term.
examples.zh: 英格兰法律讨论课考察「合同的实际可行性」，也就是虚构交易少了一项条款还能不能实际运作。

examples.en: We distinguished a merely useful addition from a term needed for business efficacy in the English law exercise.
examples.zh: 在英格兰合同法习题中，我们区分了仅仅有用的补充与保持「合同的实际可行性」所必需的条款。

collocations: an argument based on business efficacy

words.enDefinition: An English law test asking whether a proposed implied term was so obvious that both parties would have accepted it.

examples.en: The mock English opinion considered the officious bystander test before discussing the proposed unstated term in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的模拟英格兰判决在讨论拟议的未明写条款前，先考察「多事旁观者检验」。

examples.en: We used the officious bystander test to ask how both fictional parties would have answered the same question.
examples.zh: 我们用「多事旁观者检验」考察虚构双方会如何回答同一个问题。

collocations: a classroom example of the officious bystander test

words.zhGloss: 合同法中的理性人标准
words.enDefinition: An objective benchmark asking what a reasonable person in the parties' circumstances would understand from the relevant words or conduct.
acceptedZhAnswers: 合同法中的理性人标准

examples.en: The seminar used the reasonable person standard for contracts to assess what the fictional reply reasonably communicated.
examples.zh: 讨论课用「合同法中的理性人标准」，评估虚构回复可以合理理解为传达了什么。

examples.en: We applied the reasonable person standard for contracts using only the circumstances supplied in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们仅依据课堂练习给出的情形，运用「合同法中的理性人标准」。

collocations: apply the reasonable person standard for contracts
consider the reasonable person standard for contracts
a classroom example of the reasonable person standard for contracts
